name: design-checklist
description: Design-development partnership and evidence-led UX/UI quality gates grounded in focused design checklists.

interface.shortDescription: Guide design development and verify outcomes.
interface.longDescription: Defines a falsifiable design hypothesis, chooses the right intervention level, accompanies implementation through evidence gates, and prevents cosmetic changes from masquerading as redesigns.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Design Checklist as a development partner: define the hypothesis, choose the intervention, guide implementation, and verify the result.
